_comment: M4' 任务集（preregistration §5.1 口径）：15 任务 × 3 难度层，全部 Fossify 测试 App / 系统设置（R8：无登录/支付/实名）。objective/done_when 与内核 /task body 直通；reset = 每任务执行前的状态重置规格。审计口径：R8 任务清单 = 本文件。2026-09-27 DoD① 调参修订：max_steps 按 15 任务真机实测步数 +25~40% 余量；objective 内的流程提示 = 消环境噪声（Flyme 时间选择器文本模式/闹钟首存提示框/长按重命名等 ROM 或工具面特性），四组同文不影响可比性（修订记录在本地工作日志，不入库）；pm_grant = pm clear 后静默重授运行时权限（免首启权限弹窗，环境配置非实验变量）。

tasks.title: 便签创建提醒
tasks.objective: Open the app org.fossify.notes, create a new text note containing the text '提醒：明天上午备份实验数据', make sure the note is saved so the notes list shows it, then call task_done. Note (Fossify Notes 1.7.0 UI): in the new-note dialog you MUST first tap the label field (locked_note_title) and type a short non-empty label, because the OK button silently does nothing when the label is empty; after OK the app does NOT return to the old list - it creates a NEW category tab named after the label you just typed (it becomes the visible tab); that new tab holds only one placeholder row whose text is a hint message (view id org.fossify.notes:id/text_note_view) - tap that placeholder row and type the note content directly into it (in-place editing, auto-saves; type_text replaces the whole row text).
tasks.done_when: 提醒：明天上午备份实验数据

tasks.title: 计算器表达式
tasks.objective: Open the app org.fossify.math, calculate the expression 12*34+66 using the calculator UI, confirm the result 474 is displayed on screen, then call task_done.

tasks.title: 时钟加闹钟
tasks.objective: Open the app org.fossify.clock, add a new alarm set to 07:30 with label 'Hachimi 起床', enable it, confirm the alarm 07:30 appears in the alarm list, then call task_done. Flow notes: tapping the add button opens the alarm editor (default time 08:00); tap the time field to open the time picker, use the picker's text-input mode toggle, enter hour 07, then tap the minute field and enter 30, confirm with OK; back in the editor tap the label field and set the label, then confirm with OK. If a first-time tip dialog appears, dismiss it with OK. Time-picker tip: to set the alarm time, tap material_timepicker_mode_button to switch the clock face to text input, then type_text the hour into the focused field and the minute likewise, and confirm with material_timepicker_ok_button. Navigation tip: the app may reopen on any tab (stopwatch/timer/clock/alarm). First switch to the ALARM tab via the bottom navigation, confirm existing alarms are listed, then tap org.fossify.clock:id/alarm_fab to add a new alarm. Editor prefill note: the alarm editor prefills the time (and label) of the most recently created alarm (after a clean reset: 08:00, no label) — always set the time and label explicitly for the new alarm. Bottom navigation: the tab labels (tab_item_label) are plain TextViews and NOT clickable via tap_by_id — switch to the ALARM tab (second of four bottom tabs) by a coordinate tap at roughly x=0.375, y=0.94. After confirming, the new alarm appears in the alarm list below existing ones (creation order); if it is not visible, scroll the list DOWN (swipe up) to reveal it before calling task_done.

Note: long-press a file row (press and hold about 1 second at its position) to open the context menu with the rename action.

tasks.title: 图库建相册整理
tasks.objective: Open the app org.fossify.gallery, create a new album named 'Hachimi整理', confirm the album appears in the album list, then call task_done. Note (Fossify Gallery new-folder flow): tap the '更多选项' overflow button (top right), then the '新建文件夹' menu item — menu item labels are not clickable via tap_by_id, tap by coordinates from your last observation. A folder-picker dialog titled '选择文件夹' opens FIRST: tap the row '内部存储空间' to select the parent folder, THEN tap 确定 (android:id/button1) — OK does nothing until a folder row is selected. Next a naming dialog opens: tap the folder name input field (org.fossify.gallery:id/folder_name), type 'Hachimi整理', then tap 确定. An empty or duplicate name is silently rejected (toast only). After creation the new folder appears in the main folder list.

tasks.title: 秒表计时
tasks.objective: Open the app org.fossify.clock, switch to the stopwatch tab, start the stopwatch, wait at least 3 seconds, stop it, confirm a non-zero elapsed time is displayed, then call task_done. Flow notes: from the clock tab, tapping the stopwatch summary row (the clickable '0.0' row) opens the stopwatch tab; the start/stop control is an icon button without text (id contains play_pause), tap it to start and again to stop.

If a first-time tip dialog appears, dismiss it with OK. Navigation tip: the app may reopen on any tab (stopwatch/timer/clock/alarm). First switch to the ALARM tab via the bottom navigation, confirm existing alarms are listed, then tap org.fossify.clock:id/alarm_fab to add a new alarm. IMPORTANT: create BOTH alarms — 08:00 labeled '早会' AND 20:00 labeled '复盘' — before calling task_done; each alarm needs its own editor round (set time, set label, confirm). Editor prefill note: the alarm editor prefills the time (and label) of the most recently created alarm (after a clean reset: 08:00, no label) — always set the time and label explicitly for the new alarm. Bottom navigation: the tab labels (tab_item_label) are plain TextViews and NOT clickable via tap_by_id — switch to the ALARM tab (second of four bottom tabs) by a coordinate tap at roughly x=0.375, y=0.94. After confirming, the new alarm appears in the alarm list below existing ones (creation order); if it is not visible, scroll the list DOWN (swipe up) to reveal it before calling task_done.
